_comment: Default glossary applied to every locale. Each entry maps an English source term to the target-language rendering the AI should produce. For brand/product names we want preserved verbatim, target = source. Per-locale overrides (e.g. for Cyrillic-script locales) can live in bin/translations/glossary-{locale}.json — those are merged on top of this file. Keys are case-insensitive matched on whole-word boundaries. Multi-word entries are intentionally listed BEFORE their single-word prefixes (e.g. 'TranslatePress AI' before 'TranslatePress') because matches are checked in order and we want the longer-and-more-specific hit recorded.
